notes:
POC scope: deploy Redwood Private into Aurum Shield VPC using provided Terraform workspaces + Helm chart. Customer will run TF apply from their CI (GitLab runners in VPC). SE to supply documented TF modules and Helm values; expect a handful of updates for cluster role bindings and nodegroup sizing. Security asks: HSM-backed KMS (customer uses AWS CloudHSM), immutable audit logs exported to S3 in region, SSO via SAML with SCIM provisioning, retention controls for logs, and quarterly access reviews. Networking: must support VPC endpoints and no public ingress to control plane; prefer private subnets and NAT for egress to Redwood control plane if required.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed 2026-02-14):
- Successful terraform-based deployment into customer VPC without manual infra changes.
- Helm-based chart install of inference runtime + console.
- KMS integration: generate and use customer-managed CMKs for secrets and key wrapping (HSM proof-of-possession required).
- Audit logging: all token-level events stored in S3 + CloudTrail cross-check; ability to export to SIEM.
- Integration tests: chat p95 < 120ms for 512-token window at target concurrency, throughput >= 200 req/s for embeddings route.
- Security sign-off from Aurum SecOps and legal sign-off on data residency language.
- Hand-off doc + runbook and removal procedure documented.

What happened so far: short demo in staging (ff link above). First perf run slightly above target — SE tuned batching and quantization settings (redwood optimize suggestions) and saw improvement; still need to validate at scale. Legal has redlined a data residency clause (wants explicit region lock + audit right). Network team requested a VPC peering maintenance window (2 weeks from now) to establish peering and route tables.

Quotes from CTO: "We cannot accept any control-plane egress outside our EU region for production workloads" — this drives regional deployment + S3 residency constraint.

Open action items: SE to deliver updated TF modules that support KMS key import and private endpoints (due 2026-03-08); infra to run large-scale perf test (2026-03-12); AE to align with legal on SLA language (2026-03-18).
